name: Landu (Hongkong Landu Innovations Technology Co., Limited)
summary: Hong Kong-registered filament company with large-scale production in Shenzhen and Dongguan — a 50,000 sq m manufacturing centre running roughly 3,000 tons per month. Sells budget-priced LANDU-branded filament, resin and accessories, and is the confirmed OEM behind Kingroon-branded filament.

oem_relationships.notes: User-verified (research/verified-oem-relationships.md). Landu's own About page does not mention Kingroon; recorded as owner-verified ground truth without external corroboration.

product_lines.name: PLA / PLA Basic / Refill PLA Basic
product_lines.notes: Base economy PLA; refill SKUs are spool-less packaging of the same material.

product_lines.name: Hyper PLA+
product_lines.notes: Toughened PLA reformulated for high-speed printing — both the toughening and high-flow deltas apply.

product_lines.name: Silk PLA Rainbow / Gradient / Tri Color / Dual Color
product_lines.notes: Silk base with along-strand gradient dyeing; tri/dual-colour SKUs are coextrusions rather than pure gradients.

product_lines.name: PETG / Rapid PETG / Refill Hyper PETG
product_lines.notes: Standard and high-flow PETG; catalog has no high-flow PETG id.

product_lines.name: ABS / Hyper ABS / Refill Hyper ABS

additional_notes: Registered at Peter Leung Industrial Building, Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, with operations and manufacturing in Shenzhen and Dongguan. https://landu3d.com/ redirects to landustore.com. Also sells photopolymer resins and accessories including filament dryers, build-plate adhesives and spool adapters; it is not confirmed to sell build plates or print surfaces themselves, so makes_plates is left unset. Among the cheapest labels in this cluster — bulk/bundle pricing around $7.91-11.68/kg. Markets 'localized production strategies to reduce shipping costs and environmental impact'. Its 3,000 t/month capacity suggests it likely supplies further unnamed labels beyond Kingroon.

provenance.conflicts: Unverified lead: retail listings titled 'Landu Elegoo PLA' (Slickdeals) suggest Landu may also supply or co-label Elegoo-branded filament. This is not in the owner-verified file and is not encoded as an oem_relationship pending verification. The Kingroon relationship itself is owner-verified but externally uncorroborated.
